dogecoin.text: @UhOhItsLiam @MarkAttwood @elonmusk It's the other way around. DogeCoin has existed since December 2013. Elon is just a supporter of DogeCoin (along with other digital assets), and named the Department Of Government Efficiency (DOGE) after the meme.

@UhOhItsLiam @MarkAttwood @elonmusk didn't create DogeCoin. It was created by Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer.

DogeCoin lacks smart contract capabilities, and is only capable of 33 transactions per second, making it unsuitable for a single, global, digital currency.
